panel_measure_definition: price divided by net income per diluted share of the most recently PUBLISHED fiscal year. Trailing, not forward. Fiscal years are treated as first usable 15 months after the year label (March of N+1 for FY(N)), which can only make the figure staler, never earlier.

caveats: TRAILING, not forward: this is not an NTM P/E. The anchor labels it via `measure`.
Earnings step annually; within-year variation is price movement.
Fiscal years are treated as first usable in month 15 after the year label (Mar of N+1 for FY(N)). Conservative: can only be staler, never look ahead.
SURVIVORSHIP: the universe is today's listings, so delisted names are absent.
Loss-makers are excluded rather than assigned a multiple.
Multiples above 400x are dropped as near-zero-earnings artefacts.
HIERARCHY: a ticker inside a sub-industry appears under BOTH its sub-industry id and its parent sector id, so the two levels are overlapping samples, not disjoint ones.
panel_meta.measure_definition: price / (net income per diluted share of the most recently PUBLISHED fiscal year)

notes: Market-observed quantiles come only from a configured valuation panel. The arithmetic Gordon leg is an independent cross-check, never a substitute for observation.

The market-observed band requires a valuation panel (date, sector, forward multiple). MRI's local sector ETF file is price-only by construction, so no multiple can be derived from it; see docs/ANCHOR_METHODOLOGY.md §5.
